selection_context: Supplementary diagnostic specified after observing weak v1 training batches, before any control training or evaluation. It does not replace the fixed two-seed1600step experiment.
launch_condition: Run if the primary adapted checkpoint fails the v1 two-fact acquisition gate, within the existing one-hour GPU allocation.
question: Under a simpler matched two-fact-only training distribution, does direct local-attention access to the fact records resolve acquisition difficulty?

parent.reason: Already designated primary before the experiments; not selected as the better performer. No inference about training-seed variance from this one-parent diagnostic.

arms.name: attention32
arms.interpretation: Facts and query require cross-record neural memory.

arms.name: attention128
arms.interpretation: All95 input bytes fit in one attention segment; neural memory still exists. This is a task-learnability control, not a fair replay-method baseline.

matched: Same initial learned tensor values and count, training episodes, input bytes, target labels, query ranks, final-step rule, optimizer and update budget. Only local attention geometry differs between these two controls.

training.objective: Full256-way answer-position cross-entropy. Both controls start from the original shared checkpoint, not a selected adapted checkpoint.

evaluation.namespace: Fresh heldout-key development assignments; reserved test keys excluded.
evaluation.memory_reset: At segment128 all short inputs fit in one segment, so segment reset should be a no-op. Do not apply the v1 normal-minus-reset gate to this control.

analysis.unit: Paired whole episodes; keep the two K2 query outcomes together.
analysis.criterion: Report full-vocabulary accuracy and paired attention128-minus-attention32 interval, plus legal-answer mass and last-value heuristic. >=80% is the same descriptive acquisition target. This exploratory diagnostic does not rescue a failed v1 replay comparison.
